candidate.title: Why RAG Fails on Multi-hop Questions (and How GraphRAG Fixes IT)
candidate.description:
In this 6-minute walkthrough, I show why a perfectly normal RAG pipeline can still give wrong-but-traceable answers on multi-hop questions, and how GraphRAG fixes that without changing the LLM.

We cover:
– Standard RAG: documents → chunks → embeddings → retriever → LLM
– A benefits-style coverage question where RAG misses a critical exclusion clause
– Modeling the domain as a small knowledge graph (Diagnosis → Procedure → Plan → Clause)
– Graph-aware retrieval and a graph trace that leads to the correct answer
– Where this pattern applies: benefits, insurance, contracts, product catalogs, supply chain

If you’re interested when I publish a small demo repo for this pattern, connect with me here or follow my updates on LinkedIn.
